summary: Corrected design for FIX-PM-DECOMPOSE-CLOSEOUT-STEP-UNREACHABLE-PAST-RETURN-AND-MINT-OMITS-NEXTAGENT after qa's CHANGES_REQUESTED. qa's blocker CONFIRMED and reproduced end-to-end on synthetic fixtures: shipped Step 3e (commit e6a4858ae) resolves $row from in_progress[]+active_sprints[].tasks[] only. On a ready[]/backlog[] parent the CLOSEOUT branch writes 'null + {...}' = an id-less ghost row (validator: 'task_board.done[0].id: expected string, received undefined'), and the '|| echo' shell tail swallows that to exit 0; the PARTIAL branch is a schema-valid identity write that STILL resets .head, so it applies, exits 0, and leaves the parent stale — the exact occ-1/2/3 symptom. Live census matches qa: children[]-bearing rows sit backlog 10 / done 9 / ready 6 / in_progress 1. ROOT CAUSE named: a hand-enumerated lane subset was substituted for the schema's lane set, in the transform AND in the 08-14 acceptance fixture that should have caught it — so qa's proposed fix list (backlog/ready/in_progress/active_sprints) is rejected as another hand-list (omits review/qa/done_verified/archive/closed_sprints). Invariant LANE-SET-DERIVATION adopted: discover lanes structurally from .task_board, hand-name only the TERMINAL set and apply it as an exclusion from a live default. NOT re-opened: the 'next_agent: null is schema-invalid' claim — qa's non-confirmation independently re-verified (the only null is inside .head, HeadSchema:324 is nullable). Design ships fixture-executed jq for: lane-agnostic locate() (6 cases proven), 3-layer fail-loud (in-jq error() refuse-idiom mirroring qa/flow/main.md:211, shell '|| { echo >&2; exit 1; }' matching Step 3c's own neighbour, mandatory post-write re-read probe per fail-loud-protocol AC-3), a 3-WAY disposition replacing the shipped binary (A CLOSEOUT-TERMINAL with del(.next_agent) + full children union / B DELEGATED-HELD no hold_reason / C PARTIAL hold_reason SET — because children[] flips is_epic_wrapper and devteam-wrapper-autoclose.jq would otherwise steal C's pm re-entry hop), a mandatory dependents-retarget (deps_satisfied requires DONE_VERIFIED, so closing a decomposed parent to DONE strands its dependents forever — pm hit this live), and a prose-ceiling pre-flight (measured: a 34-byte in-place patch hard-rejects on an over-ceiling guarded-lane row; 21 such rows live). ARCHITECTURAL RULING: the transform leaves the flow doc for scripts/pm-decompose-closeout.jq — an inline markdown heredoc cannot be unit-tested, which is exactly why AC-1/AC-2/AC-3 were only ever 'replayed manually' and why pm hand-rolled two variants in one day; it also deepens the 120L flow-file cap breach. 4 rows to mint, zone-split, sequenced: (1) FIX-PM-3E-FAILLOUD-HOTFIX agent-father XS ship-now stop-the-bleed; (2) FIX-PM-3E-CLOSEOUT-SCRIPT-LANE-AGNOSTIC developer M; (3) FIX-PM-3E-FLOWDOC-REPOINT-3WAY-DISPOSITION agent-father S depends_on 2; (4) FIX-FLOWDOC-RETURN-REACHABILITY-CHECKER developer S (AC-3, still unbuilt). PO note: agent-father fails is_dev_role so rows 1/3 are not auto-dispatchable.
